about: The most valuable printings in each set (sets, keyed by set code) and in each Commander deck and Secret Lair drop (decks, keyed by 'set:deck name' as in precons.json). Each entry: u is the day it was ranked, r the rows [name, collector number, finish n|f|e, price in US dollars, 1 if legal in Commander else 0] (deck rows add the set code). Prices are Scryfall's (TCGplayer's market price), without shipping or tax; only the top 25 worth $5 or more are kept. Built by tools/build_top25.py from Scryfall's default_cards bulk file; don't edit by hand.
